meetingAlreadyCurrent: A meeting is already in progress.
meetingDateTaken: A meeting already exists on that date.
endBeforeArchive: Finish the meeting first (wrap-up step) before archiving it.
notAMember: Your address does not match any team member.
ownRequestsOnly: You can only remove your own requests.
ownKudosOnly: You can only remove your own kudos.
ownCommentsOnly: You can only remove your own comments.
ownTopicsOnly: You can only remove your own topics.
ownActionsOnly: You can only change the status of your own actions.
ownCheckInOnly: You can only edit your own check-in.
ownBirthdayOnly: You can only change your own birthday.
votesUsed: You already used your {count} votes. Remove one to vote elsewhere.
encryptionNotConfigured: Token encryption is not configured on the server (SECRET_KEY): tokens cannot be saved.
secretKeyTooShort: SECRET_KEY must be at least {min} characters long to encrypt tokens.
secretUnreadable: Unreadable token: enter it again in the settings.
secretKeyChanged: Unreadable token (did SECRET_KEY change?): enter it again in the settings.
gitlabTokenRefused: GitLab refuses the token: check it in the settings.
gitlabGroupNotFound: GitLab group not found or not reachable with this token: {group}
matrixUnreachable: The Matrix server does not answer ({url}).
matrixTokenRefused: Matrix refuses the token: it may have expired (account signed out). Enter a new one in the connector.
matrixForbidden: The account may not post in this room: invite it to the room and accept the invitation.
matrixRoomNotFound: Matrix room not found: check its id (!… or #…).
avatarFormat: Photo format not supported (PNG, JPEG or WebP).
ownAvatarOnly: You can only change your own photo.
gitlabNotConfigured: GitLab is not configured: the admin must enter a token in the settings.
gitlabTokenFirst: Enter and save the GitLab token first.
slugInvalid: Use 1 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and dashes, without a dash at the start or the end.
slugReserved: This address is kept for Ronde itself. Pick another one, such as {slug}.
confirmationMismatch: The confirmation text does not match.
personExists: This address is already in the directory.
roleNotAssignable: Owners and admins already have every permission: custom roles are for members and guests.
lastOwner: A workspace needs at least one owner: make someone else owner first.
alreadyMember: This person is already a member of the workspace.
samplePerson: This person is part of the sample meeting's fictitious team: they cannot be invited.
invitationExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
invitationInvalid: This invitation is invalid or was revoked.
invitationOtherEmail: This invitation was sent to {email}. Sign in with that address to accept it.
tooManyInvitations: You have sent {count} invitations today: that is the limit. Try again tomorrow, or connect a directory (SCIM, LDAP) to add many people at once.
sectionRoleTaken: Each role (done, planned, blockers, other) can be given to one section only.
sectionLabelRequired: Give each custom section a name.
alreadyParticipant: This person already takes part in the meeting.
lastHost: A meeting needs at least one host: make someone else host first.
moduleDisabled: This module is turned off for this meeting.
moduleNotInEdition: This module is not included in your plan.
noUpcomingDate: The schedule has no date left: pick a date, or add a rule in the settings.
connectorRefused: {host} refused the message (error {status}). Check the address in the connector.
connectorTargetMissing: This notification has no destination: pick a room or recipients.
connectorInUse: This connector is used by notifications of meetings; remove them first.
connectorSecretRequired: This connector needs its token or webhook address.
notifyNoRule: No “check-in reminder” notification is set up for this meeting (Settings › Notifications).
retroWrongPhase: This is not possible at this step of the retro.
retroTooManyCards: That is already a lot of notes: group your ideas.
retroOwnCardsOnly: You can only change your own notes.
retroNoColumns: A custom retro needs at least one column.
agendaLocked: The agenda cannot change while a session is running.
agendaModuleOff: Turn the “{module}” module on before adding its block to the agenda.
pokerTooManyItems: That is already a lot of items for one session.
pokerNotLive: Cards are picked during the planning poker step.
pokerUnknownCard: This card is not in the deck.
pokerRevealed: The cards of this item are already shown: the host can start a new round.
pollNeedsOptions: A choice poll needs at least two options.
pollInvalidAnswer: This answer does not fit the poll.
drawNeedsPeople: At least two people present are needed for this draw.
parkingFull: The parking lot is full (50 subjects): discuss or remove some first.
githubTokenRefused: GitHub refuses the token: check it in the settings.
githubRateLimited: GitHub limits the requests for now: try again in a minute, or enter a token in the settings.
videoBbbUrl: Enter the address of the BigBlueButton server.
videoUnreachable: The video call server does not answer. Try again in a moment, or ask the host to check its settings.
publishLive: This session was started live: end it from the control room to archive it.
licenseFormat: This is not a Ronde license key: paste the whole key, starting with “ronde_lic_v1.”.
licenseSignature: This license key is not valid: it was changed or not issued by Ronde.
licenseUnknownKey: This license key was signed by a key this version does not know: update Ronde, or ask for a new key.
featureNotInPlan: This feature is not part of this instance's plan.
slackNotConfigured: The Slack app of this instance is not set up yet: its administrator gives it the keys of the app created in Slack.
roleNameTaken: A role already has this name.
domainInvalid: This is not a domain name: enter something like acme.com.
domainExists: This domain is already in the list.
domainTaken: Another workspace of this instance has already verified this domain.
domainRecordMissing: The DNS record was not found yet. Check its name and value, and try again in a few minutes.
ssoNotConfigured: No single sign-on provider is set up on this instance: requiring it would lock these people out.
ssoDomainNotVerified: A provider signs in addresses of verified domains only: verify each domain first.
ssoProviderRefused: The identity provider settings were refused: {details}
ldapUrlInvalid: The directory address must start with ldap:// or ldaps://.
reportNoRecipient: Add at least one address to send the report to.
logoFormat: Logo format not supported (PNG, JPEG or WebP).
aiNotConfigured: The AI assistant is off, or has no key: an administrator sets it up in the workspace settings.
aiKey: The AI provider refused the key. An administrator can check it in the workspace settings.
aiAnswer: The AI assistant gave an answer that could not be used. Try again.
aiUnavailable: The AI assistant cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
ticketExists: This action already has a ticket.
ticketFailed: The ticket could not be created: {detail}
sourceFailed: {tool} did not answer as expected. Try again in a moment.
sourceNotFound: {tool} found nothing there. Check the address or the key; if it is private, add a token that can read it.
sourceRefused: {tool} refused the token: check that it is valid and allowed to read this project.
sourceTokenRequired: {tool} needs a token to show its projects.
sourceAddressInvalid: This does not look like a {tool} address or project. Check what you entered and try again.
teamsLinkExpired: This link has expired or is not valid. In Teams, mention Ronde in the channel to get a new one.
teamsNotConfigured: The Microsoft Teams app of this server is not set up yet: its administrator first registers it in Microsoft Azure.
videoRoomFailed: The video room could not be created: {detail}
calendarNotSet: Pick a calendar account for this meeting first.
calendarFailed: The calendar could not be reached: {detail}
transcriptionOff: Transcription is not set up for this meeting: allow it in its settings, and set up a speech-to-text service in the workspace settings.
audioTooLarge: This piece of sound is too large.
notRecording: The session is not being recorded.
alreadySubscribed: This workspace already has a subscription: manage it from the billing portal.
absencePeriod: Pick a first and a last day, in order, a year apart at most.
phoneMissing: Add your mobile number to your profile first: the test goes there.
phoneInvalid: Enter the mobile number in international form, like +33612345678.
sessionHeldToday: A session of this meeting was already held today.
guestLinkInvalid: This guest link is invalid, has expired or was revoked. Ask the host for a new one.
projectMembersOnly: Only the people working on this project can change its sheet.
projectProgramme: A project cannot belong to itself or to one of its own projects, and programmes go three levels deep at most.
projectSheetHeld: {name} is writing this project sheet right now. Wait until they are done.
checkInChanged: The check-in was changed elsewhere meanwhile. Its changes are now in your draft: check it, then save again.
joinParticipantsOnly: Only the people taking part in the meeting can join a line.
ratingNotYet: The meeting can be rated once it reaches its wrap-up.
sourceRateLimited: {tool} limits requests for now. Try again later; without a token, adding one raises the limit.
sourceRefusedTracker: {tool} refused the issue tracker’s token. An administrator can check it in the workspace settings.
sourceServerAdminOnly: Only an administrator of the workspace can import from {host}. Members import from github.com, gitlab.com, Atlassian Cloud and Linear.
tokenInvalid: This token holds characters a token cannot have (spaces, line breaks). Copy it again from the tool.
feedbackTooMany: You sent several messages in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
feedbackTooLarge: The message is too large to send. Try a smaller screenshot.
feedbackImageFormat: The screenshot must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
